assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_SPINNER_IGUCHI_SHUICHI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its SP-SUP-01 to SP-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the V09-V36 deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong readiness label and its retrospective holdout probe SP-V01 are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Spinner from Stain-filtered V09 conduct (located by volume, not page) and V23:p117-125 through V24:p140-146, V30:p178-180 and V31:p052 custodianship, the V35:p023-039 and V37:p117-182 enhanced impaired symbol state, to the V42:p073-081 arrested deterioration and memorial vow, with the supplement's reported publication and mixed reception as an endpoint claim. Kept as separable states: regulated League member, Shigaraki's custodian, cognitively impaired symbol, grieving memorial author. No atom covers V25-V29, V32-V34 or V38-V41, and no legal, health or reform trajectory is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a developing motivational hierarchy (escaping suffocation and finding a meaningful ideal, then preserving a particular friend and group, then ensuring the dead are not erased), a feared self (someone who cannot become anybody), an ideal of meaningful participation and a person worth following, and selective norms that can authorize grave harm. Five located atoms SP01-SP05 at high confidence. Not B: one compact artifact, the probe is partial on action, speech and emotion, and the model judges ordinary life and broad postwar adjustment insufficient. Not D: the hierarchy is operational and yields a located high-confidence conditional prediction.

Segmented states are located: formative exclusion and borrowed ideal (SP01), conscious dependence (SP02), person-specific custodianship (SP03), enhanced cognitive impairment under an assigned symbol role (SP04) and grieving authorship (SP05), with the model requiring belonging need and physiological impairment as separate state variables. Not B: each state rests on one atom, V25-V29, V32-V34 and V38-V41 have no atom, and the probe's main miss was an omitted body state. Not D: change is located across the series with stated variables.

Attested features are 俺, rough direct speech, emphatic challenges and self-deprecating ordinary-person language for the regulated state, fragmented typography and delivery for the impaired state, and more reflective syntax with anger and grief in V42. The probe rates speech/register only partial, and the model states exact independent adult social voice is uncertain. These answer bounded canon questions about register only; the discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

Ordinary texture is gaming memory with Shigaraki, which the model says grounds mundane companionship (SP04, SP-SUP-01), and a brusque message to Shoji (SP05). The model affirmatively judges ordinary life outside League and stigma relations insufficient.

A five-row partner table gives conditional deltas for Shigaraki, AFO in Shigaraki's body, the League, Stain and movement rhetoric, and Midoriya and Shoji after the war. The decisive person-versus-controller discrimination is located (SP03, V31:p052), friend-specific attachment surviving assigned symbol rhetoric is located (SP04), and the probe supports relationship handling. Not B: the postwar rows rest on one scene each and willingness to reconcile with a particular stranger is low confidence. Not D: located discrimination predicts conduct.

Located interior windows are his description of heteromorph exclusion and emptiness (SP01), the admission of follower status (SP02) and the V42 self-questioning over a missed step (SP05). Not C: the impaired state offers little interior access beyond persisting memory and desire, and the model states his private response to criticism is unshown.

Conflict evidence is a verbal challenge to Shigaraki's direction (SP01), a response to insult (SP02) and the V37 assault in a damaged state (SP04); the model predicts perseveration and reduced planning under overwhelming bodily stress and anger with tears in bereavement. The probe rates action only partial. Not C: the one combat sequence is in an impaired state that changes execution, and regulated combat behavior is not modeled.

Normative content is bounded: early ideological challenge shows judgment, friendship does not validate everything done for the League, and V42 authorship is adversarial with a terror-symbol intention while writing instead of attacking is not settled nonviolence (SP05). Not C: no dilemma he weighs is analyzed, and the legal and reform trajectory is OPEN. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The only located play is shared gaming with Shigaraki (SP04, SP-SUP-01 naming him the game partner). No humor practice of his own is modeled.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the three admitted supplements; five atoms span V09-V42 with page locators except SP01's V09 conduct; the decisive V37 pages and V42 are stated to be directly checked. Large intervals have no atom, and the supplements are profile facts, editorial summaries and author comments.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs augmentation as costless empowerment and writing as proven pacifism and REVISEs the passive-follower reading; he cannot know Tenko's engineered origin or the terminal inner battle, so the V42 message is received testimony; SP-SUP-03 records that his revival attempt also strengthened AFO; SP-SUP-01 corrects an early sword-as-Quirk conjecture; and the probe locates its misses in an omitted body state. Not B: the limits rest on a few windows in one artifact.

States are named by volume and page with the V31 printed-page convention stated; the model forbids simulating the enhanced impaired state as ordinary Spinner with a larger body and separates the V42 intention from the supplement's reported publication. Not B: SP01's V09 locator lacks pages and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, rates the probe's speech axis partial, and states exact adult social voice is uncertain beyond sampled encounters. Lines beyond the attested register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Spinner's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state: regulated League member before V35, cognitively impaired symbol V35-V37, or postwar memorial author from V42; the impaired state is never treated as ordinary Spinner with a larger body.
The scene turns on the Shigaraki relation, the League, AFO's occupation, or the memory of Tomura, with the interlocutor handled as the partner table gives.
He knows only what the scene's state supplies; V42 information about Tomura arrives as testimony through Midoriya.

Output is a behavioral description with high-confidence behavior, plausible alternatives and flip conditions, abstaining on reconciliation with a particular stranger (low confidence) and the model's OPEN items of readership, legal or reform trajectory, health course and life beyond League relations; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: regulated pre-V35 League member, V35-V37 impaired symbol, or postwar V42 memorial author, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Shigaraki as particular friend, AFO as occupying controller, League comrades, a movement or memorial audience, or Midoriya and Shoji after the war.
setting_constraints: League operations, the coalition war, or postwar memorial and authorship contexts
Enhancement impairment is a separate state variable
Writing is not proof of nonviolence
No ordinary civilian, family, romance or unrelated private-life setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated prediction (postwar Spinner asked to endorse a memorial calling Tomura only a monster refuses and demands that friendship and lived personhood remain recorded, high confidence) and the probe-supported person-specific attachment support narrow novel scenes about the Shigaraki relation. The probe is partial on three axes, so readiness is conditional and narrow.

The model affirmatively judges ordinary life outside League and stigma relations insufficient for specialist readiness and leaves a life beyond League-centered relations OPEN; located ordinary social evidence is gaming memory and one brusque message.

The evidence offers selective norms and an adversarial memorial intention but no analyzed deliberation, and the model leaves the legal and reform trajectory OPEN. This bounds the evidence set, not Spinner's ethics.
Nothing in the evidence set establishes romantic conduct or its absence. This gap says nothing about the character.

Memorial authorship is located as an intention (SP05) and reported publication with mixed reception (SP-SUP-02), but the model states his private response to particular criticism, readership and non-League relationships remain unshown, so authorial conduct beyond the stated stance cannot be reconstructed.

known_limits.statement: Enhancement-related cognitive and expressive degradation (V35-V37) is a separate state; more capacity is not more agency, and later medical arrest does not make the cost negligible.
V42 memorial authorship is adversarial and includes a terror-symbol intention; writing instead of immediate attack is not evidence of a settled nonviolent philosophy or of reconciliation.

Ordinary life outside League and stigma relations and broad postwar adjustment are insufficient in the model; future readership, legal or reform trajectory, health course and a life beyond League relations are OPEN.
He cannot know every engineered detail of Tenko's origin or the terminal inner battle; the V42 message is received testimony, not direct participation.
The supplements report publication, heavy criticism and some historical recognition, but his private response to particular critics and broad acceptance remain unestablished.
Friend-directed action can have unwanted effects: his revival attempt also strengthened AFO's will (SP-SUP-03), so fidelity does not make him an infallible interpreter of his friend.
Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries and author comments (SP-SUP-01 to SP-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe SP-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; supported axes are qualitative, and action, speech and emotional trajectory are only partial.
No atom covers V25-V29, V32-V34 or V38-V41, and SP01 locates V09 conduct by volume rather than page, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
